title: Canonical localized module Hom comparison by signed evaluation
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $E,I$ arbitrary cochain complexes of $R$-modules, and $Q$ the localization to $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the product total Hom complex $H=\operatorname{Hom}_R^\bullet(E,I)$ [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex] and the direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Let $\operatorname{ev}_{E,I}:\operatorname{Tot}(E\otimes_R H)\to I$ be the signed evaluation chain map whose restriction to the $(p,q)$ summand sends $x\otimes f$ to $(-1)^{pq}f_p(x)$, using the actual $p$-th product projection $f_p:E^p\to I^{p+q}$ of $f\in H^q$. This is the coordinate-characterized evaluation of [lem-pod-projective-hom-evaluation-model], whose evaluation clause holds for arbitrary $E,I$. Using the existing derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], define the canonical comparison $j_{E,I}:QH\to R\operatorname{Hom}_R(QE,QI)$ to be the left tensor-Hom transpose of $QE\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}QH\xrightarrow{\mu_{E,H}}Q\operatorname{Tot}(E\otimes_R H)\xrightarrow{Q\operatorname{ev}_{E,I}}QI$, where $\mu$ is the native localization lax tensorator. No boundedness, projectivity, flatness or K-injectivity is assumed in this definition.
